info.title: ccu-addon-battery API
info.description: The addon's own API, served behind the system's session gate at /addons/battery/. A browser sends the gate cookie; a script logs in first (docs/api.md). Writes carry the X-CCU-Addon-Request header. Times are Unix milliseconds in answers; requests take milliseconds, RFC 3339 or a date.

error.description: a code: invalid, not-found, unknown-device, ambiguous-device, unavailable, busy, csrf, forbidden, idempotency-key-reused, …

type.description: a key of the battery table's types: AA, AAA, C, D, 9V, LR44, CR2016, CR2032, CR2450, CR123A, fixed, pack, lead12V

step.description: the jump of rule B, V

Override.description: changes what the battery table says; a missing field leaves the value below alone

rechargeable.description: true: the slots hold NiMH cells (unless chemistry says otherwise)

image.description: the platform's picture of the model (/config/img/devices/250/...), absent without one

life.description: the device's battery lives; absent without an accepted change

price_cents.description: the price of ONE battery of this slot, in cents of the user's currency; the slot's cost is count x price_cents

voltage_confirmed.description: the reading after the confirmation window

name.description: in lists: the device's name from the system

rule.description: the rules that fired, e.g. A+B; E for a manual entry

interface.description: needed when the address is on several interfaces, or with model for a device the addon never saw

model.description: with interface: records a change of a device that left the system (created as retired)

at.description: Unix milliseconds, an RFC 3339 string, or YYYY-MM-DD (noon in the system's time zone)

source.description: manual by default (import in a bulk request)

external_id.description: the client's own key, unique per source: the same id again is a duplicate

at.description: Unix milliseconds, an RFC 3339 string, or YYYY-MM-DD (noon in the system's time zone)

row.description: the array index + 1, or the CSV line

applied.description: false on a dry run and on an atomic request with an error

ts.description: Unix milliseconds, an RFC 3339 string, or YYYY-MM-DD (noon in the system's time zone)

skipped.description: dropped by the downsampling, or a row at that millisecond is there

Summary.description: completed lives: count, shortest, longest, mean and median in days

running_days.description: how long the current batteries are in

hint.description: short: a low battery while the running life is well below the device's (or its model's) average

Life.description: the time between two accepted changes of a device, or since the last one (to absent)

cost_per_year_cents.description: mean cost per year of the lives with a price

BatteryRow.description: one vendor + product line + size ever recorded

avg_price_cents.description: mean price per battery where recorded

batteries.description: the batteries used in this model, longest mean life first

Trend.description: the voltage regression over the last 60 days

reach_low_at.description: when the line meets the device's low level (ms); absent when it does not fall

expected_days.description: the life the forecast counts with

basis.description: own: the device's own lives (median), model: the model's lives in this installation, table: the battery table's typical life, trend: the voltage trend pulled the date forward

due_at.description: the forecast date (ms): the last change + the expected life - 14 days, or the trend's date if earlier

stock.description: what is at home, per battery type

token.description: ntfy: sent as a bearer token
